title: Query History & AI Model Updates
description: Release v0.8.2 - Enhanced query history management, updated AI model support (Gemini 2.5/3.0, OpenAI o1/4.5), and improved usage tracking accuracy.
highlights: Query History: Delete, Copy, Share, and 'Clear All' actions
Updated AI Models: Support for Gemini 2.5/3.0 & OpenAI o1/4.5

items.title: Enhanced Query History
items.description: Full management of your query log directly from the sidebar.
details: Added 'Clear All' button (trash icon) to wipe history
Added context menu for individual queries with Copy, Share, and Delete options
Implemented backend endpoints for secure query deletion

items.title: Updated AI Models
items.description: Access the latest and most efficient models from Google and OpenAI.
details: Gemini: Added Gemini 2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, 3.0 Pro Preview, 3.0 Flash Preview
OpenAI: Refined available list to o1-mini, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4.5 Preview
Prioritized 'Flash' models for faster default responses

items.title: Robust AI Usage Tracking
items.description: Migrated token usage tracking to the backend to ensure complete accuracy.
details: Tokens are now logged immediately upon generation, analysis, or formula creation
Eliminated potential data loss from frontend reporting issues
Ensures accurate quota management for Pro/Free tiers

items.title: Connection Management
items.description: Resolved critical issues preventing connection cleanup.
details: Fixed `Can not execute DELETE statement` error when deleting connections
Improved ID handling for SurrealDB record deletion
